name: SheepFarm repeatable registration bonus
summary: register checks villages[msg.sender].timestamp == 0 and credits a bonus, but only addGems sets timestamp. Repeated registration creates unpaid gems that upgrades and sellVillage convert into withdrawable BNB.

loss.notes: Conservative net floor for three November payouts only; full episode loss is unresolved. Inherited $72,037 was a single-EOA profit estimate without structured provenance and is not retained as episode USD.

limitations: Direct code identity and deployment are established; runtime hash and full age-history review remain unresolved.
Full unauthorized depletion attributable to repeated bonus credits remains unresolved (source-5).

sources.note: Verified direct SheepFarm source: register never sets villages[user].timestamp; addGems requires msg.value / 5e14 > 0. eth_getLogs(Newbie topic 0x84c0c87e6f85175060980f01774fbad3ec4757a9a21ef663e2bd93b72b10c2e0, victim, blocks 22904709–23084708 in 10,000-block windows) first repeats an address at block 22917657: 0xbe4bd65656cc9ca28d29b017c8b37de4c7bd5b0f received bonus 10 in tx 0x97f486a1cd66cc9e98cf135639d79def953e97f4ef5b843edf54456de2826c28 (22917650), then bonus 10 in tx 0x5bf8a02788b47cc9c8ed68ce0e9d80c40ff0205c1a365b63d80c452033e5a4f2 (22917657). Seed anchor callTracer: 402 register calls, one paid addGems, 0.7644 BNB to ephemeral 0xa448a215bbb54d4bd67f6fbb931874f019e7bd8a, 0.015625 BNB protocol fees. Etherscan V2 txlist(victim, 22904709–23096000) returns >10,000 normal transactions; complete with overlapping range 23080710–23096000 (1,612 rows). txlistinternal complete with first 10,000 rows then 23088499–23096000 (8,805 rows), deduplicating by hash/traceId. Creation tx 0x6a982015482c9a2f0b70f0d627089d87c52ee4862e0c85b9615031e72dda249a, block 22904709, index 244, timestamp 1667990286, creator 0x3f99830a7f0b919a4ef1d462055255faa0bb1c72. Earliest successful exercise is the second free-bonus credit at block 22917657 index 217, timestamp 1668030045 (source-7): its successful receipt emits Newbie bonus 10, and register requires timestamp==0 without setting it. Payout is not required for this anchor. Unresolved: redemption of these excess credits and complete multi-actor depletion attributable to them. Next: trace the earliest duplicate users through addGems/upgrades/sellVillage/withdrawMoney and classify later internal payouts by repeated-registration event history; sum unauthorized depletion excluding campaign-supplied BNB. The prior note equating attacker EOA profit with gross campaign loss was removed.
Verified source retrieved with Etherscan V2 getsourcecode: https://bscscan.com/address/0x4726010da871f4b57b5031e3ea48bde961f122aa#code

Admission floor only: successful callTracer frames in source-1, source-8 and source-9 pay helper contracts respectively 0.7644, 1.5288 and 1.5288 BNB. All calls into the farm in those transactions supply respectively 0.0005, 0.001 and 0.001 BNB; subtracting them gives 3.8195 BNB. Excluding protocol fee recipients makes this conservative. Source-10 historical BNB quote is $275.10 at 1668550336: net minimum $1,050.74445. This covers only three November campaign transactions and supports admission; it is not full episode loss. Earlier repeated-credit users, other actors, and later payouts still require entitlement attribution and campaign summation (source-5).

limitations: Full episode loss remains unresolved: source-5 establishes earliest successful repeat credit and records next investigation; source-11 establishes only an admission floor.

notes: Intent of the earliest repeated-registration caller is unknown; attackerAddresses identifies the later November campaign sender.
